shortDescription: Create/destroy or attach/detach Block Storage volumes in DigitalOcean

options.name: block_size
options.description: The size of the Block Storage volume in gigabytes. Required when I(command=create) and I(state=present). If snapshot_id is included, this will be ignored. If block_size > current size of the volume, the volume is resized.

options.name: command
options.description: Which operation do you want to perform.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the Block Storage volume.

options.name: droplet_id
options.description: The droplet id you want to operate on. Required when I(command=attach).

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. There are several other environment variables which can be used to provide this value. i.e., - C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN).

options.name: project_name
options.description: Project to assign the resource to (project name, not UUID). Defaults to the default project of the account (empty string). Currently only supported when C(command=create).

options.name: region
options.description: The slug of the region where your Block Storage volume should be located in. If I(snapshot_id) is included, this will be ignored.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: The snapshot id you would like the Block Storage volume created with. If included, I(region) and I(block_size) will be ignored and changed to C(null).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used for polling DigitalOcean's API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: volume_name
options.description: The name of the Block Storage volume.
